```{r}
header <- c('sourceTaxonIDs',
            'sourceTaxonName',
            'sourceTaxonLevel',
            'sourceSpeciesName',
            'sourcePhylum',
            'sourceKingdom',
            'interactionType',
            'targetTaxonIDs',
            'targetTaxonName',
            'targetTaxonLevel', 
            'targetSpeciesName',
            'targetPhylum',
            'targetKingdom')

#reading in GLOBI output
interactions_sources <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/secundary_interactions_sources_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header)

interactions_targets <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/secundary_interactions_targets_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header) 
 
primary_interactions <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/vespa_velutina_interactions_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header) 

raw_interactions <- rbind(interactions_sources,
                          interactions_targets,
                          primary_interactions)
```


```{r}
#remove refuted interactions
refuted_interactions <- read.csv("~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/refuted_interactions_light.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote="",
  header=FALSE,
  col.names=header) 

raw_interactions <- raw_interactions%>%
  mutate(id = paste0(sourceSpeciesName, 
                     sourceTaxonName,
                     interactionType,
                     targetTaxonName,
                     targetSpeciesName))

refuted_interactions <- refuted_interactions%>%
  mutate(id = paste0(sourceSpeciesName, 
                     sourceTaxonName,
                     interactionType,
                     targetTaxonName,
                     targetSpeciesName))

test <- raw_interactions%>%
  filter(id%in%refuted_interactions$id)

raw_interactions_cleaned <- raw_interactions %>%
  filter(!id%in%refuted_interactions$id)

write.csv(raw_interactions_cleaned, 'raw_interactions_cleaned.csv')
raw_interactions_cleaned <- read.csv('~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/raw_interactions_cleaned.csv')
```

```{r}
#clean all species to match with GitHub backbone

source_species_raw <- raw_interactions_cleaned%>%
  select(sourceSpeciesName, 
        sourcePhylum,
        sourceKingdom)%>%
  mutate(sourceKingdom=str_replace(sourceKingdom, 'Metazoa', 'Animalia'))%>%
  rename(SpeciesName = "sourceSpeciesName",
         Phylum = "sourcePhylum",
         Kingdom = "sourceKingdom")
  
target_species_raw <- raw_interactions_cleaned%>%
  select(targetSpeciesName, 
        targetPhylum,
        targetKingdom)%>%
  mutate(targetKingdom=str_replace(targetKingdom, 'Metazoa', 'Animalia'))%>%
  rename(SpeciesName = "targetSpeciesName",
         Phylum = "targetPhylum",
         Kingdom = "targetKingdom")

species_unmatched <- rbind(source_species_raw,
                           target_species_raw)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  filter(SpeciesName!="")%>%
  mutate(GBIF_key=NA)

final_output <- data.frame()

for (row in 1:nrow(species_unmatched)) {
    species <- species_unmatched[row, "SpeciesName"]
    king <- species_unmatched[row, "Kingdom"]
    
    output <- name_backbone(name= species, kingdom= king)
    
    if ('species'%in%names(output)) {
       
    output <- output%>%
            select(c("usageKey",
               "scientificName",
               "canonicalName",
               "rank",
               "status",
               "confidence",
               "matchType",
               "kingdom",
               "species",
               "kingdomKey",
               "speciesKey"))
    
    output$species_name_network <- species
    output$ king_network <- king
    
    if (!nrow(final_output)==0){
        final_output <- rbind(final_output,
                          output)
    } else {
      final_output <- output
    }
    
     }
  
}

write.csv(final_output, '~/GitHub/AlienCSI_VM_JH/Vespa/Romania/all_species_matched_to_GBIF_backbone.csv')
```

        sourceKingdom,
        interactionType,

 mutate(interactionType = str_replace(interactionType, "kills", "preyson"))%>%
 mutate(sourceKingdom=str_replace(sourceKingdom, 'Metazoa', 'Animalia'))%>%

 distinct()
